title: HELIOS: Adaptive Model And Early-Exit Selection for Efficient LLM Inference Serving
selection_reason: The abstract describes multi-model early-exit selection and loading only likely-to-be-used layers to reduce token latency and memory use, then reuse memory savings for larger serving batches. This is a direct inference-serving optimization.
